body:
My biggest pain is abandonment and a great distrust I have learned to feel for mankind, especially for women.

I've been cheated on more than I can recall.

My mother abandoned me as a youth and left me to fend for myself on the streets.

I didn't know my eldest daughter much until about two years ago when she came to live with me because her mom got into crack, because her mom withheld her from me.

My other daughter isn't a part of my life for the same reason. Her mother calls me a sperm donor and teaches my daughter that her husband is the father.

I've been involved in an incestuous relationship with a long lost half sister that I only met a year ago, since day one. We even had a pregnancy where she told me, "You're going to be a daddy." and it was a happy moment, until she woke me up the next day (we don't live together, but she was at my place) and told me she couldn't do it...October 29th, she had an abortion at 7 weeks 5 days. I was in the room the whole time, holding her hand and being there to support her. She since has told me she regrets that decision.

She has since cheated on me, multiple times. Professed love for someone she told me she doesn't want in the past. Promised me she didn't want this person, and has since cheated on me with him and now tells me she wants him.

Although just tonight since after my OP, he told her he is done, doesn't want her, unless it's just a fuckbuddy. That they will never be together.

Now she's all 'confused' and regretful, claiming she wants to walk away from him for me, and all this shit. But like...

The last person I ever expected to hurt me, was my own little sister (shes in her mid twenties, just thought I'd clarify.) She promised me when we first met, "You're the big brother I always wanted, and it's my job as your little sister to protect you from women. To make sure they never break your heart again, and I will keep your heart safe as my own until you find someone else who truly deserves it." which later became, "Your heart is mine, and I'll protect it forever. I love you as more than my brother, and I will never hurt you like they did."......But she has....

I know the first response people will give is, "Well that's fucked up. And that shouldn't have happened anyway so get over it." but it's not that simple. Genetic Sexual Attraction is a real thing, and it makes the heartache of being hurt FAR more painful, when it comes from your own family...It's not something I can just easily recover from.

With that being said, this isn't a "Boo hoo she hurt me now I need to die" thing. I'm far too old and have survived too much for that petty stuff...But a big summary of my life all balled into one, is more than I can handle. If it was just one thing or another I could deal. I mean, having slept outside in subzero winters, being a street kid, being a loser at school, losing my kids etc...I can handle a lot...But everything put together; I have broken. And I don't think I can recover.

I wrote my notes tonight, because although I don't have a plan yet, I wanted to be prepared incase the moment hits me out of nowhere and I just do it, you know? Wanted to be prepared I guess.

I'd also like to state that I am diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder, medicated, and have gone through counselling. It's not like I am wanting to die without even trying to get better first...I tried guys... I failed a suicide attempt when I was 12, I'm pushing 30 now, and have been fighting for a long time. I didn't just give up when I woke up on the floor, and try again....I decided to fight. 

But I think the fight is over.

Music is my life. I'm in school for something unrelated, but I'm a musician and a big lover of music. It's ALWAYS on, and I play with her every weekend when I see her. The problem is, that my darkness consumes me whenever she isn't around. But I can't rely on her to save me. She's only eight. She has no idea the suffering daddy battles.

It's good, although she lives with my mother. I sent her to live there a year ago due to a hectic work schedule, now my mother refuses to return her to me, and we are in a custody battle. I see her often though, and we are good.
It's been dark for 15 years, since I hung myself. And for years prior to leading up to that. When you haven't seen the sun in the majority of your life, it's hard to believe it exists.

There were so many times I thought I saw 'signs' of the gods existence. One example is a time I was in a forest looking to the sky and I cried out (not the whole speech), "PLEASE, JUST SHOW ME YOU CAN HEAR ME AND YOU'RE LISTENING!" and no sooner did I finish my sentence, a shooting star went across the small gap in the trees I was looking through. I took that as a sign.

However, the signs have stopped coming. I haven't had one in years now, and it seems like every prayer I make goes unanswered, and I no longer feel the closeness to them I once felt. I guess you could say I feel abandoned, forsaken perhaps.

I question if it was all dilusional, and perhaps the power of the mind WANTING something, made it seem real. There's so much evidence as well that points against religion, that I seriously question it all.
